name: Tan De Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Tan De Tech Co., Ltd, established in 2013 and headquartered in Douliu, Taiwan, specializes in automotive lighting technology. The company innovates, manufactures, and distributes advanced LED headlights for a diverse array of car manufacturers. Its product offerings also encompass a full suite of exterior vehicle lighting fixtures, including taillights, turn signals, fog lights, and daytime running lights.
